persona.title: PhD Candidate — Aerospace Engineering
bio: I am a 28-year-old aerospace engineer completing my PhD at Politecnico di Torino.
My research focuses on reduced-crew operations in civil aviation, combining knowledge engineering, NLP, and experimental flight simulation to develop intelligent pilot-assistance systems.
Driven by curiosity and rigour, I am looking for opportunities in both industry R&D and academic research.

skillAreas.items: Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers), MATLAB/Simulink, Git, LaTeX, SQL basics.
NLP (BERT fine-tuning, text classification), speech recognition (Whisper), ontology design (OWL/RDF, Protégé), knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Cypher).
A320 FNPT II full-flight simulator, Tobii eye-tracking systems, multi-modal data acquisition and fusion, experimental test design.
Linux, Docker, MS Office, technical writing, scientific presenting.
